tests.name: provenance_security_h2_kind_swap_changes_abi_not_ir
expectations: E2.1 baseline B and variant K exports are accepted, each printing '<QUALIFICATION> 1 actions into'
E2.2 lawful identity: K bindings are recomputed by bindings(); K source_hash, program_hash and abi_hash all differ from B
E2.3 action-000000.ir.bin bytes of K equal those of B; marker actions[0].ir_hash equal

E2.4 K manifest with members source_hash, program_hash, abi removed equals B manifest with the same members removed (so ir_hash, input_count, groups, qualification, compiler_hash, open_predicates, debit_sources and statement_emissions are equal)
E2.5 K manifest source_hash, program_hash and abi each differ from B
E2.6 K abi equals B abi with program_hash set to K's program_hash and statements[0].kind='Fee', statements[1].kind='Transfer'; nothing else in the abi differs
E2.7 K abi.actions[0].statements equals the literal [Fee alice->treasury amount 0, Transfer alice->treasury amount 1, Let local value 4, Transfer alice->treasury amount 5, Fee bob->treasury amount 6]
E2.8 K debit_sources equals the alice and bob role rows in that order (unchanged from B)
E2.9 marker identities differ; marker build equal
E2.10 B bundle reopens under B inputs and K bundle reopens under K inputs (each prints 'source-static-recompile-admitted 1 actions; identity')
E2.11 B bundle reopened under K source and bindings is refused with 'static-compile: marker-identity'
tests.security_reading: Transfer/Fee kind is not bound by the IR or by statement_emissions; it is visible only through the committed source/program/ABI. Kind attribution therefore rests on the source commitment, not on any runtime or native check.

tests.name: provenance_security_h3_payer_change_changes_debit_metadata_not_ir
expectations: E3.1 B, P1 and P2 exports are accepted with '<QUALIFICATION> 1 actions into'; P1 and P2 reopen under their own inputs
E3.2 lawful identity: P1 and P2 bindings recomputed by bindings(); each source_hash, program_hash and abi_hash differs from B
E3.3 P1 and P2 action-000000.ir.bin bytes equal B's
E3.4 P1 payer set changes: debit_sources equals [alice row] (B has [alice row, bob row])
E3.5 P1 manifest minus source_hash, program_hash, abi, debit_sources equals B's minus the same members
E3.6 P1 abi equals B abi with program_hash replaced and statements[4].from='alice'
E3.7 P2 payer reattribution with unchanged set: debit_sources equals [alice row, bob row], identical to B
E3.8 P2 manifest minus source_hash, program_hash, abi equals B's minus the same members (debit_sources and statement_emissions equal)
E3.9 P2 abi equals B abi with program_hash replaced and statements[0].from='bob'
E3.10 B, P1 and P2 marker identities are pairwise distinct
tests.security_reading: Payer (from) is not bound by the IR or statement_emissions. debit_sources is an unordered role set with no statement index: P2 shows a per-statement payer reattribution that leaves debit_sources byte-identical. Per-statement payer attribution exists only in the committed ABI statements. Nothing here authenticates, funds or checks any debit.

tests.name: provenance_security_h4_rehashed_map_tampering_refuses_fresh_source_mismatch
tests.baseline: export of PROVENANCE_SOURCE with bindings(PROVENANCE_SOURCE) to directory out
tests.reseal_procedure: write mutated manifest bytes; in the original marker JSON set leaves['action-000000.manifest.json'].sha256 = codec::hash(bytes), leaves[..].bytes = byte length, actions[0].manifest_hash = same sha256; identity = codec::object_hash(marker without identity); write marker as serde_json pretty
harness_preconditions: P4.1 resealing the unmodified manifest reproduces the original marker identity and byte-identical marker file
P4.2 each mutation's text edit patterns occur exactly once in the original manifest
P4.3 each mutated manifest parses and equals the original parsed manifest with exactly the stated JSON-level change applied, and differs in bytes

mutations.change: statement_emissions[0] and [1] exchange instruction_start/instruction_end/group_start/group_end: entry0 becomes 41/75/16/29, entry1 becomes 7/41/3/16
statement_emissions[2].dynamic_fields[0] {group 31, offset 3} becomes offset 2 (still inside width 4)
M4 and M5 together (a /1-shaped manifest without the map)

expectations: E4.1 every mutation M1-M6, after reseal, is refused by --inspect-static with message containing 'static-compile: fresh-source-mismatch' (therefore marker-identity, action-leaf-identity and leaf-identity all accepted the recomputed hashes)
E4.2 after each refusal the bundle files on disk equal exactly what the test wrote (reopen writes nothing); IR and source leaves equal the original export
E4.3 restoring the original manifest and marker bytes yields an accepted reopen
tests.security_reading: The emission map is producer-side only (no Deserialize). A caller who rewrites the map and recomputes every public hash is caught solely by fresh-recompile byte equality. H4 is the regression for that single dependency.

non_claims: No runtime value, guard activity, debit funding, custody, authorization, ledger, proof or native correspondence is checked or claimed
H2/H3 IR equality is a static byte observation of the exported IR, not evidence that Transfer and Fee settle identically
No baseline IR digest is claimed; the optional MORI_PROVENANCE_BASELINE_BINARY branch belongs to Sol's normal test and is unchanged
No U0-U7, M1-M17, MC, SP or G exit closes from these expectations

out_of_scope.H5: review-only; no ordinary unsigned product call is added (ordinary-path closure not separately classified)

if_results_disagree: Stop and report. Do not edit these expectations to match output; examine source first.
